title: Big5PersonalityEssays: Introducing a Novel Sythetic Generated Dataset Consisting of Short State-of-Consciousness Essays Annotated Based on the Five Factor Model of Personality

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dataset balance and skewness by analyzing the descriptive statistics, label distribution, and inter-trait correlation of synthetically generated essays to ensure unbiased representation across the Five Factor Model (FFM) personality traits.
